appended.suggestion: The screen emits strong_buy (16/22, five families including cheapness/quality/GARP/dividend/risk) on a contractor with sub-12% margins (Moat fail), current ratio 1.23, RSI 33 and a price<50<200 downtrend, while cyclical_exposure_detected is false and every overlay is off.
